story.title: Story 6: Blocked And Degraded Deterministic Maintenance State

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 6 AC/TC coverage across async-thread readiness, thread-view materialization, smart-compact degraded handling, and workbench inspection surfaces, then ran targeted story suites plus the story and epic gates.

newFindings.title: Thread View materialization still drops missing full-fidelity source messages silently
newFindings.evidence: src/thread-view/services/thread-view-materializer.ts:343-354 only validates that selected turn ids exist, and lines 446-450 filter unresolved messageIds out before emission. In a temp-store reproduction, adding message-missing-materialization to a selected full-fidelity turn and calling ThreadViewMaterializer.materializeThreadView() returned ok:true, issues:[], full_fidelity renderedStatus:"ready", and emitted only the two existing messages instead of surfacing THREAD_VIEW_STATE_CONFLICT.

newFindings.title: Workbench chunk inspection does not report unresolved source-turn references
newFindings.evidence: src/context-workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:143-179 only marks a chunk invalid when sourceTurnIds is empty, while src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:511-523 already treats any unresolved turn id as CHUNK_STATE_INVALID. openChunkDetail() at lines 605-627 returns the chunk-reader result unchanged. Reproduced by persisting a closed chunk with sourceTurnIds:["turn-missing"] and calling WorkbenchQueryService.openChunkDetail(): the response was ok:true with chunk.issues:[], so inspecting the chunk does not report the invalid state explicitly.

newFindings.title: Threshold-degraded compact results are not preserved as degraded workbench state
newFindings.evidence: src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:662-721 computes LOWER_THRESHOLD_UNREACHED but persists only status:"incomplete" on the draft view, and src/commands/smart-compact.ts:135-144 returns that degraded result before any generated-output metadata is updated. src/context-workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:274-299 and 469-500 derive thread usability only from maintenance blockers plus projectionSummary.generatedOutput, so the threshold failure disappears from normal inspection. Reproduced by running runSmartCompact() with requestedLowerBound=2 and 100/0/0/0 bands: the command returned compactStatus:"degraded" with LOWER_THRESHOLD_UNREACHED, but a follow-up WorkbenchQueryService.openThread() reported usableStatus:"ready", blockers:[], and no degraded output metadata.

additionalObservations: Targeted story suites, npm run verify, and npm run verify-all all passed; the blockers above come from uncovered direct materialization / inspection paths rather than failing configured gates.
Reviewed runtime placeholder handling stayed explicit and persisted; no extra fake adapter or shim path was found beyond the intended deterministic placeholder artifacts.
